query: What product attributes are associated with higher satisfaction scores?

per_column.name: taste_quality
per_column.rationale: Well-separated ordinal categories (excellent/good/acceptable/poor) describing a genuine product attribute that can be grouped and compared against satisfaction.

per_column.name: health_outcome
per_column.rationale: Distinct interpretable categories capturing health effects; an external associational dimension that segments cleanly for comparison against satisfaction.

per_column.name: ingredient_transparency_trust
per_column.rationale: Interpretable trust/transparency categories, a real product attribute distinct from satisfaction; supports meaningful segmentation.

per_column.name: value_proposition_price_parity
per_column.rationale: Clear value/price categories that form an external dimension groupable against satisfaction.

per_column.name: product_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: An overall quality verdict (excellent/good/poor) is essentially a paraphrase of overall satisfaction rather than a distinct attribute; largely restates the focus.

per_column.name: consistency_quality_control
per_column.rationale: Consistency/QC categories are an interpretable, well-separated attribute distinct from overall satisfaction.

per_column.name: convenience_usability
per_column.rationale: Interpretable convenience scale; a real product attribute suitable for segmentation against satisfaction.

per_column.name: intended_use_effectiveness
per_column.rationale: Effectiveness-for-purpose categories are interpretable and distinct, supporting relationship discovery.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_commitment
per_column.rationale: Binary intent-to-repurchase; interpretable segmentation, though it partly reflects rather than explains satisfaction. Still an informative associational split.

per_column.name: seller_recommendation_endorsement
per_column.rationale: A would-recommend endorsement is a near-synonym of satisfaction/positive sentiment rather than a product attribute; largely restates the focus.

per_column.name: expectation_fulfillment
per_column.rationale: Meeting/exceeding expectations is effectively a restatement of satisfaction rather than an independent attribute that would explain it.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine, well-separated, interpretable product attributes (taste, health outcome, transparency, value, consistency, convenience, effectiveness) that a human explorer can segment on and compare against satisfaction, directly serving the query about which attributes associate with higher scores. Several columns, however, restate the focus rather than opening an external relationship: product_quality_verdict, seller_recommendation_endorsement, and expectation_fulfillment are essentially overall-satisfaction proxies. Non-trivial NULL rates in some columns modestly weaken comparisons. As a set, the schema supports informative relationship discovery well but is diluted by the restatement columns.
